measurements.env: Apple Silicon, APFS, repo venv, offline temp DBs, synthetic numeric records

structure.detail: one sqlite db per owner account at <user_data_dir>/usage.sqlite3
llm_calls(call_id PK, started_at, session_id, turn_id, source, usage_json) + started_at index; no workspace column
one row per provider attempt including failed/interrupted/estimated; retry loop wraps every attempt
measured streams and instrumented clients record on close, incl. interrupted
INSERT OR IGNORE on call_id primary key
year-window full materialization, per-row TurnUsage summaries with call_details
WAL enabled per write; per-call close checkpoints and removes sidecars

recovery.mechanism: duplicate insert ignored via primary key
history snapshots compensate lost ledger writes; merge_records dedups by call_id in 500-id batches
missing or corrupt table tolerated on read via mode=ro

orphans.issue: rows with empty session_id/turn_id/source for provider calls outside a turn binding
session deletion never removes llm_calls rows; no cascade or fk
delete_user never removes user_data_dir, orphaning the whole ledger db
ledger_path or record_call failure drops the durable record permanently for unbound calls
no workspace dimension; owner-global rows cannot be scoped for prune or attribution

retention_gap: no DELETE, VACUUM or prune on llm_calls anywhere in deeptutor/; only other-store retention exists (redis streams stream_retention_seconds, session snapshot prune in workspace/data_migration.py:873-885)

recommendations.action: daily time-window prune with incremental vacuum; 2 rolling years cap ~474MB at 1000 calls/day
aggregate-then-prune into llm_calls_daily rollups; >45x row reduction and removes 1.06s/432MB year read
cascade delete llm_calls by session_id on session hard-delete; remove user_data_dir in delete_user
paginate month-wise over idx_llm_calls_time or stream rows into aggregate_usage
persist workspace_id at write time for scoped prune and exact attribution

dedup.guide-usage-ledger: user guide only, no growth/retention analysis
dedup.test-usage-ledger: functional write/merge tests, merged in da856ad67 (v1.6.9)

constraints: offline static analysis + throwaway temp dbs only; no service started; no source changes outside evidence/
